profile: release, codegen-units=1; no optional SIMD, custom RUSTFLAGS, PGO or LTO
scope: 65536 original assertions; dense and sparse ASN, 16-byte-delta sparse IPv6, up to 65 nested IPv6 prefixes per cluster, and 64 duplicate IPv4 assertions per key. Shared and 100% unique eight-byte payloads. Each of 256 queries is compared with a brute-force scan of original targets and complete ID/target/payload lists. Caller batches 1/8/32/256 rotate through the same query corpus and use the existing scalar-query visitor API; no new batch API, interleaved execution or cross-query SIMD. No JSON/allocation/network work in timed visitor loop.
limitations: Two serial descriptive passes on a live desktop. Fixed warm query corpus and default build establish workload baselines, not optimization gains, deployed capacity or broad tail-latency guarantees.
